description: Retrieve the current native ETH balance of a wallet on Ethereum or Base and, optionally, balances for up to 20 specified ERC-20 token contracts. Returns factual on-chain balances observed at request time and does not evaluate wallet ownership, solvency, transaction safety, or whether a transaction should be executed. USE WHEN: an agent needs the current ETH balance or balances of specific ERC-20 tokens for an EVM address. DO NOT USE WHEN: the agent needs transaction details (evm_transaction_hash_lookup), current gas price (evm_gas_price_lookup), historical balances, or a transaction execution decision. Parameter semantics: chain accepts exactly ethereum or base; address must be 0x followed by exactly 40 hexadecimal characters; optional tokens accepts up to 20 ERC-20 contract addresses.

address.description: One EVM wallet address to inspect.
